primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in whole liver fat at Week 6.
efficacy_outcome: Whole liver fat changed by −7.97% with placebo, +2.84% with PF-06835919 75 mg (p=0.1654), and −25.43% with PF-06835919 300 mg (p=0.0395).
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths in any arm: placebo 0/19, 75 mg 0/17, and 300 mg 0/17.
